  "situation": "An employee of a DOE contractor applied for a security clearance. The Local Security Office raised concerns under Guideline G because the employee had been cited for Minor in Consumption in 2008 and a psychologist evaluated him as a habitual or binge drinker whose judgment was impaired about twice a month. The psychologist did not diagnose an alcohol use disorder but recommended twelve weeks of outpatient group therapy or a year of abstinence. The employee reported drinking four to five beers once or twice weekly and occasional larger binges since 2011, but testified he had abstained for fourteen weeks before the hearing and had begun individual therapy shortly before the hearing, without enrolling in the recommended group program. Witnesses attested to his trustworthiness and recent abstinence, while the psychologist testified that the employee had not made satisfactory progress and his prognosis remained guarded.
